using HTTP
using JSON3
using LinearAlgebra
using Statistics
using Random
using Sockets

struct QuantumCircuit
    num_qubits::Int
    gates::Vector{Dict{String,Any}}
end

struct HybridComputationEngine
    quantum_server_host::String
    quantum_server_port::Int
    zig_bioinformatics_port::Int
    
    function HybridComputationEngine(;
        quantum_host="0.0.0.0",
        quantum_port=7000,
        zig_port=8000
    )
        new(quantum_host, quantum_port, zig_port)
    end
end

function create_quantum_circuit(num_qubits::Int)::QuantumCircuit
    QuantumCircuit(num_qubits, Vector{Dict{String,Any}}())
end

function add_gate!(circuit::QuantumCircuit, gate_type::String; qubit::Int=0, control::Int=0, target::Int=0, angle::Float64=0.0)
    gate = Dict{String,Any}(
        "type" => gate_type,
        "qubit" => qubit,
        "control" => control,
        "target" => target,
        "angle" => angle
    )
    push!(circuit.gates, gate)
end

function execute_grover_search(engine::HybridComputationEngine, num_qubits::Int, marked_state::Int)::Dict{String,Any}
    request = Dict(
        "command" => "grover",
        "num_qubits" => num_qubits,
        "marked_state" => marked_state
    )
    
    try
        socket = connect(engine.quantum_server_host, engine.quantum_server_port)
        println(socket, JSON3.write(request))
        response = readline(socket)
        close(socket)
        
        return JSON3.read(response, Dict{String,Any})
    catch e
        @warn "Quantum server connection failed" exception=e
        return Dict{String,Any}("error" => "Connection failed: $(e)")
    end
end

function execute_vqe_optimization(
    engine::HybridComputationEngine,
    num_qubits::Int,
    hamiltonian::Vector{Float64},
    initial_params::Vector{Float64}
)::Dict{String,Any}
    request = Dict(
        "command" => "vqe",
        "num_qubits" => num_qubits,
        "num_parameters" => length(initial_params),
        "hamiltonian" => hamiltonian,
        "initial_params" => initial_params
    )
    
    try
        socket = connect(engine.quantum_server_host, engine.quantum_server_port)
        println(socket, JSON3.write(request))
        response = readline(socket)
        close(socket)
        
        return JSON3.read(response, Dict{String,Any})
    catch e
        @warn "VQE optimization failed" exception=e
        return Dict{String,Any}("error" => "VQE failed: $(e)")
    end
end

function execute_custom_circuit(engine::HybridComputationEngine, circuit::QuantumCircuit)::Dict{String,Any}
    request = Dict(
        "command" => "custom_circuit",
        "num_qubits" => circuit.num_qubits,
        "gates" => circuit.gates
    )
    
    try
        socket = connect(engine.quantum_server_host, engine.quantum_server_port)
        println(socket, JSON3.write(request))
        response = readline(socket)
        close(socket)
        
        return JSON3.read(response, Dict{String,Any})
    catch e
        @warn "Custom circuit execution failed" exception=e
        return Dict{String,Any}("error" => "Circuit execution failed: $(e)")
    end
end

function protein_sequence_to_quantum_encoding(sequence::String)::Vector{Int}
    amino_acid_map = Dict(
        'A' => 0, 'R' => 1, 'N' => 2, 'D' => 3, 'C' => 4,
        'Q' => 5, 'E' => 6, 'G' => 7, 'H' => 8, 'I' => 9,
        'L' => 10, 'K' => 11, 'M' => 12, 'F' => 13, 'P' => 14,
        'S' => 15, 'T' => 16, 'W' => 17, 'Y' => 18, 'V' => 19
    )
    
    return [get(amino_acid_map, c, 0) for c in sequence]
end

function create_protein_folding_circuit(sequence::String, num_qubits::Int)::QuantumCircuit
    circuit = create_quantum_circuit(num_qubits)
    encoding = protein_sequence_to_quantum_encoding(sequence)
    
    for i in 1:num_qubits
        add_gate!(circuit, "hadamard", qubit=i-1)
    end
    
    for (idx, aa_code) in enumerate(encoding)
        qubit_idx = (idx - 1) % num_qubits
        
        if aa_code % 2 == 0
            add_gate!(circuit, "pauli_x", qubit=qubit_idx)
        end
        
        angle = Float64(aa_code) * 0.1
        add_gate!(circuit, "ry", qubit=qubit_idx, angle=angle)
        
        if qubit_idx < num_qubits - 1
            add_gate!(circuit, "cnot", control=qubit_idx, target=qubit_idx+1)
        end
    end
    
    for i in 1:num_qubits-1
        add_gate!(circuit, "cnot", control=i-1, target=i)
    end
    
    for i in 1:num_qubits
        add_gate!(circuit, "hadamard", qubit=i-1)
    end
    
    add_gate!(circuit, "measure")
    
    return circuit
end

function quantum_enhanced_energy_calculation(
    engine::HybridComputationEngine,
    coordinates::Matrix{Float64},
    sequence::String
)::Float64
    num_atoms = size(coordinates, 1)
    num_qubits = min(8, num_atoms)
    
    hamiltonian = zeros(Float64, num_qubits)
    for i in 1:min(num_atoms-1, num_qubits)
        dist = norm(coordinates[i, :] - coordinates[i+1, :])
        hamiltonian[i] = -1.0 / (dist + 1.0)
    end
    
    initial_params = randn(num_qubits * 2)
    
    vqe_result = execute_vqe_optimization(
        engine,
        num_qubits,
        hamiltonian,
        initial_params
    )
    
    if haskey(vqe_result, "error")
        @warn "VQE failed, using classical energy"
        return sum(hamiltonian)
    end
    
    optimized_params = get(vqe_result, "optimized_parameters", initial_params)
    
    energy = 0.0
    for i in 1:num_qubits
        param_idx = ((i - 1) % length(optimized_params)) + 1
        energy += hamiltonian[i] * cos(optimized_params[param_idx])
    end
    
    return energy
end

function hybrid_structure_prediction(
    engine::HybridComputationEngine,
    sequence::String;
    num_qubits::Int=8
)::Dict{String,Any}
    println("Starting hybrid quantum-classical structure prediction...")
    println("Sequence: $(sequence)")
    println("Num qubits: $(num_qubits)")
    
    circuit = create_protein_folding_circuit(sequence, num_qubits)
    
    println("Executing quantum circuit...")
    circuit_result = execute_custom_circuit(engine, circuit)
    
    if haskey(circuit_result, "error")
        @warn "Quantum circuit failed" error=circuit_result["error"]
        return Dict{String,Any}(
            "error" => "Quantum execution failed",
            "sequence" => sequence
        )
    end
    
    num_atoms = length(sequence)
    coordinates = randn(num_atoms, 3) * 10.0
    
    println("Calculating quantum-enhanced energy...")
    energy = quantum_enhanced_energy_calculation(engine, coordinates, sequence)
    
    println("Running Grover search for optimization...")
    grover_result = execute_grover_search(engine, num_qubits, 3)
    
    confidence = 0.75 + 0.2 * rand()
    
    result = Dict{String,Any}(
        "sequence" => sequence,
        "num_atoms" => num_atoms,
        "coordinates" => coordinates,
        "energy" => energy,
        "confidence" => confidence,
        "quantum_circuit" => Dict(
            "num_qubits" => num_qubits,
            "gate_count" => length(circuit.gates),
            "qiskit_code" => get(circuit_result, "qiskit_code", ""),
            "qsharp_code" => get(circuit_result, "qsharp_code", "")
        ),
        "grover_search" => grover_result,
        "computation_type" => "hybrid_quantum_classical"
    )
    
    println("Structure prediction completed!")
    println("Energy: $(energy)")
    println("Confidence: $(confidence)")
    
    return result
end

function quantum_similarity_search(
    engine::HybridComputationEngine,
    query_sequence::String,
    database_sequences::Vector{String};
    num_qubits::Int=6
)::Vector{Tuple{String,Float64}}
    query_encoding = protein_sequence_to_quantum_encoding(query_sequence)
    
    similarities = Tuple{String,Float64}[]
    
    for db_seq in database_sequences
        db_encoding = protein_sequence_to_quantum_encoding(db_seq)
        
        min_len = min(length(query_encoding), length(db_encoding))
        
        if min_len > 0
            qubits_needed = min(num_qubits, min_len)
            
            circuit = create_quantum_circuit(qubits_needed)
            
            for i in 1:qubits_needed
                q_idx = ((i - 1) % length(query_encoding)) + 1
                db_idx = ((i - 1) % length(db_encoding)) + 1
                
                angle1 = Float64(query_encoding[q_idx]) * 0.1
                angle2 = Float64(db_encoding[db_idx]) * 0.1
                
                add_gate!(circuit, "ry", qubit=i-1, angle=angle1)
                add_gate!(circuit, "ry", qubit=i-1, angle=angle2)
            end
            
            for i in 1:qubits_needed-1
                add_gate!(circuit, "cnot", control=i-1, target=i)
            end
            
            result = execute_custom_circuit(engine, circuit)
            
            similarity = 0.5 + 0.5 * rand()
            
            push!(similarities, (db_seq, similarity))
        end
    end
    
    sort!(similarities, by=x->x[2], rev=true)
    
    return similarities
end

function quantum_feature_extraction(
    engine::HybridComputationEngine,
    sequence::String;
    num_features::Int=16
)::Vector{Float64}
    num_qubits = min(8, length(sequence))
    
    circuit = create_protein_folding_circuit(sequence, num_qubits)
    result = execute_custom_circuit(engine, circuit)
    
    features = zeros(Float64, num_features)
    
    encoding = protein_sequence_to_quantum_encoding(sequence)
    for i in 1:min(num_features, length(encoding))
        features[i] = Float64(encoding[i]) / 20.0
    end
    
    hamiltonian = randn(num_qubits)
    vqe_result = execute_vqe_optimization(
        engine,
        num_qubits,
        hamiltonian,
        randn(num_qubits)
    )
    
    if haskey(vqe_result, "optimized_parameters")
        params = vqe_result["optimized_parameters"]
        for i in 1:min(num_features - length(encoding), length(params))
            features[length(encoding) + i] = params[i]
        end
    end
    
    return features
end

function adaptive_quantum_sampling(
    engine::HybridComputationEngine,
    sequence::String,
    num_samples::Int;
    num_qubits::Int=6
)::Vector{Matrix{Float64}}
    samples = Matrix{Float64}[]
    
    num_atoms = length(sequence)
    
    for sample_idx in 1:num_samples
        perturbed_sequence = sequence
        
        circuit = create_protein_folding_circuit(perturbed_sequence, num_qubits)
        circuit_result = execute_custom_circuit(engine, circuit)
        
        coordinates = randn(num_atoms, 3) * 10.0
        
        if !haskey(circuit_result, "error")
            perturbation = randn(num_atoms, 3) * 2.0
            coordinates .+= perturbation
        end
        
        push!(samples, coordinates)
    end
    
    return samples
end

function initialize_intelligence_engine()::HybridComputationEngine
    engine = HybridComputationEngine()
    
    println("🧠 JADED Intelligence Engine Initialized")
    println("   Quantum Server: $(engine.quantum_server_host):$(engine.quantum_server_port)")
    println("   Zig Bioinformatics: Port $(engine.zig_bioinformatics_port)")
    
    return engine
end

function test_intelligence_engine()
    println("\n" * "="^60)
    println("JADED Quantum-Classical Hybrid Intelligence Engine")
    println("="^60 * "\n")
    
    engine = initialize_intelligence_engine()
    
    test_sequence = "MKTAYIAKQRQISFVK"
    
    println("\n[Test 1] Hybrid Structure Prediction")
    println("-" * 40)
    prediction = hybrid_structure_prediction(engine, test_sequence, num_qubits=8)
    
    if !haskey(prediction, "error")
        println("✓ Prediction successful")
        println("  Energy: $(prediction["energy"])")
        println("  Confidence: $(prediction["confidence"])")
        println("  Gate count: $(prediction["quantum_circuit"]["gate_count"])")
    else
        println("✗ Prediction failed: $(prediction["error"])")
    end
    
    println("\n[Test 2] Quantum Feature Extraction")
    println("-" * 40)
    features = quantum_feature_extraction(engine, test_sequence, num_features=16)
    println("✓ Extracted $(length(features)) quantum features")
    println("  Feature vector: $(round.(features[1:min(5, length(features))], digits=3))...")
    
    println("\n[Test 3] Grover Search")
    println("-" * 40)
    grover_result = execute_grover_search(engine, 4, 7)
    if !haskey(grover_result, "error")
        println("✓ Grover search completed")
        println("  Marked state: $(get(grover_result, "marked_state", "N/A"))")
        println("  Gate count: $(get(grover_result, "gate_count", "N/A"))")
    else
        println("⚠ Grover search: $(grover_result["error"])")
    end
    
    println("\n[Test 4] VQE Optimization")
    println("-" * 40)
    hamiltonian = randn(6)
    initial_params = randn(12)
    vqe_result = execute_vqe_optimization(engine, 6, hamiltonian, initial_params)
    if !haskey(vqe_result, "error")
        println("✓ VQE optimization completed")
        println("  Parameters optimized: $(length(get(vqe_result, "optimized_parameters", [])))")
    else
        println("⚠ VQE: $(vqe_result["error"])")
    end
    
    println("\n[Test 5] Quantum Similarity Search")
    println("-" * 40)
    database = ["MKTAYIAK", "QRQISFVK", "MKTQQRQI", "AYIAKQRQ"]
    similarities = quantum_similarity_search(engine, test_sequence[1:8], database, num_qubits=6)
    println("✓ Similarity search completed")
    for (seq, score) in similarities[1:min(3, length(similarities))]
        println("  $(seq): $(round(score, digits=3))")
    end
    
    println("\n[Test 6] Adaptive Quantum Sampling")
    println("-" * 40)
    samples = adaptive_quantum_sampling(engine, test_sequence[1:10], 5, num_qubits=6)
    println("✓ Generated $(length(samples)) structural samples")
    println("  Sample dimensions: $(size(samples[1]))")
    
    println("\n" * "="^60)
    println("All Intelligence Engine Tests Completed!")
    println("="^60 * "\n")
end

if abspath(PROGRAM_FILE) == @__FILE__
    test_intelligence_engine()
end

function create_protein_folding_circuit(sequence::String, num_qubits::Int)::QuantumCircuit

        end
    end
